title: Smashed cucumber salad with roast chicken

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything is plain whole food: chicken, potatoes, cucumbers, radishes, spring onions, yoghurt, garlic, herbs and cider vinegar.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday Tesco item at a normal price.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a roasting tray, bowl and grater, and roasting a chicken and bashing cucumbers suits a confident beginner.

works.reason: A 1.5kg chicken roasted for 80 minutes at 200°C with 750g potatoes, two cucumber sides and a yoghurt sauce gives a sound, well-seasoned dinner for four.

honest_times.reason: 25 minutes covers halving potatoes, bashing and slicing the salad, grating, carving and making the sauce, and 30 plus 50 minutes matches the 80 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: All listed ingredients and seasonings appear in the steps, with "onions" clearly meaning the listed spring onions, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Three cucumbers, used in both the smashed salad and the yoghurt sauce, make a fresh mid-May plate where cucumber is far more than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are brief, plain British English a neighbour would give.

hearty_healthy.reason: Roast chicken, potatoes and two vegetable-rich sides make a proper family dinner.
